channel.title: Evangelical Times Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Evangelical Times Limited (evangelical-times.org)

item.title: Government struggles to define ‘Islamophobia’ as free speech campaigners raise concerns
item.description: Just before Christmas, a draft government definition of ‘Islamophobia’ was leaked to the BBC, but free speech campaigners have expressed concerns that protections for ‘anti-Muslim hatred’ would mean it would not be possible to criticise the religion itself.

item.title: Christian school in Aberdeen goes from strength to strength
item.description: Dóxa Theó Christian School is a classical Christian School which opened in Aberdeen at the start of 2025 as a ministry and work started by Grace Baptist Church Aberdeen.

item.title: Major British charity criticised for telling women sex-selective abortion not against the law
item.description: A leading British charity which provides abortions for the National Health Service has come under fire for saying it’s not illegal to end a pregnancy because of the sex of the baby.

item.title: The impact of global mission celebrated at GBM annual conference in Camden
item.description: Last October, Grace Baptist Mission’s Annual Mission Day celebrated 164 years of gospel outreach under the theme ‘Mission Yesterday, Today and Tomorrow’.

item.title: Ladies conference in Ulverston considers ‘fearless faith
item.description: Twenty-five women gathered last October for the second Ladies Conference at Grace Baptist Church, Ulverston. Once again the theme was ‘Fearless Faith’.

item.title: Are you a Zionist?
item.description: Today is International Holocaust Memorial Day, and here Paul Smith assesses what is shaping modern Christian attitudes to Israel and the Holocaust.

item.title: What has Jerusalem to do with Jerusalem?
item.description: Psalm 122 calls us to ‘pray for the peace of Jerusalem’ and to seek her good. But how, precisely, is the Christian to do that? Are we to pray for the literal city of Jerusalem, or should we understand the proper noun figuratively, and relate this exhortation to the Church?

item.title: Knit together in love: Manchester conference promotes unity among like-minded churches
item.description: Last December, we at Grace Fellowship Manchester organised our first conference in a few years. It was called the ‘Fellowship Conference Manchester 2025’ because it aimed to encourage fellowship between like-minded churches.

item.title: Honouring God through the discipline of physical exercise
item.description: ‘So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God’ (1 Corinthians 10:31). Just a few months ago I found myself staring at the bathroom scale in disbelief. I was sitting at 98kg, and I’m pretty sure I’d tipped over the 100kg mark in the months running up to that morning.

item.title: DR Congo: Eight Christians were beheaded in Christmas massacre
item.description: Eight Christians have been killed in yet another attack in north-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) on 26 December, an Islamist group has claimed.
